lines: He saw 6.3 targets per game over the last three weeks, and his share of team targets stayed at 22%, the same as his season number.
He averaged 8.2 PPR points per game recently, while his usage was worth 11.0 expected points, so his scoring has lagged the work he's getting.
Seattle allows the 32nd-most PPR points per game to WRs, and the coach said Allen and Evans will start together.
